With the safety on you cannot fire it double action. So the PA-63 is perfectly safe to carry with one in the pipe. I might add that the PA-63 unlike most European autos uses the button Mag release (like the M1911) and not the butt mag release. The only problem with the PA-63 is that it has one hell of a snap because it is so light weight. If you fire the +P ammo it is even worse. WHAT I DID WAS ORDER A SET OF HEAVIER RECOIL AND FIRING PIN SPRINGS FROM WOLF SPRINGS. That tames the beast down to manageable levels. Also you might want to order a lighter hammer spring to reduce the first double action trigger pull. If you don't like a heavy trigger. Personally I tried that and went back to the original hammer spring because with the heavier firing pin spring (to keep the firing pin from striking the primer during slide recoil) I was afraid that I could get misfires.

What I really like about the PA-63 is that it doesn't pattern under clothes, and the light weight doesn't pull the side of my pants down. It is also thin enough that if you carry it in the center back position when you sit down in a chair it is not all that noticeable.

So adding up all the pluses

  1. one of the safest fire arms out there.

  2. Ease of use in a high stress environment ( only one lever to mess with)

  3. More powerful than a .380 (it will shoot a .95 grain projectile at 1250 fps vs a 95 grain projectile at 1100)

  4. Light weight

  5. small size

  6. lack of pattering

I find that the PA-63 is a almost perfect concealed carry weapon.

They are definitely neat little pistols. I'm a C&R collector and have seen many in the ads I get and on Gunbroker and was often tempted. If I did get one, always a possibility, I'd likely leave it stock, being a collector. I don't know much about that cartridge other than what I've read, but sounds good. If you reload, you may also be able to dial in a load that's perfect for what you have and help tame that recoil down a bit, too. I carry a .380 which I enjoy, and this looks like it would make a great carry pistol, as you indicated with better characteristics.
